run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier-1 government portals (AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) were queried via WebSearch for all jurisdictions. Tier-2 (water GBEs, universities/CSIRO, NSW Health/LHDs) and Tier-3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, defence primes, construction) were scanned, and source discovery was run for portal rebrands/migrations. IMPORTANT: this session's network policy blocks outbound DNS to every external domain (tender portals AND buyer sites such as acara.edu.au), so WebFetch returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND' for every URL tried and NO detail page or document could be opened. Everything captured is headline-level from WebSearch result summaries only. On this run the search index returned predominantly stale/cached pages for the Tier-1 portals, so clean current portal listings were largely not recoverable; only a small number of opportunities could be confirmed as genuinely current and buyer-originated (ACARA Website Development RFT closing 9 Nov 2026; Defence LAND 6504 EOI closing 26 Nov 2026; ACT Canberra Light Rail Specialist Advisors Panel). Open items captured on the 2026-11-02 run (buy.nsw/VIC/QTOL/ACT) were NOT re-observed this run and have not been re-asserted; they remain in the aggregate from their earlier runs. No opportunities were fabricated.
gaps: CRITICAL - NETWORK: The session network policy blocks outbound DNS to all external domains. Every WebFetch (tenders.gov.au, acara.edu.au, and others) returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND'. Consequently NO tender detail page or document could be opened or verified: all three captured entries are headline-level from WebSearch summaries only, and deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, exact values, submission mechanics and contacts could not be obtained. These domains must be allow-listed in the session network settings for a verified run.

Tier-1 portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT): WebSearch returned mostly stale/cached listings (closing dates in mid-2026 or earlier) this run. Unlike the 2026-11-02 run, current (Nov 2026) portal summaries were largely not recoverable via the search index, so current opportunities on those portals could not be confirmed and were not recorded. Deferred to a future run or an allow-listed/authenticated session.
Tenders SA search returned almost entirely South African (tenders.sa / SANRAL) results, not South Australian; no SA opportunity could be confirmed. NT QTOL returned no current items.

Tier-2 (Sydney/Melbourne/SA Water; universities/CSIRO; NSW Health/HealthShare/LHDs): only closed (pre-November 2026) opportunities or aggregator-only listings surfaced; no current opportunity could be confirmed buyer-originated. Water utilities (SA Water Source-to-Contract, Sydney Water SAP Ariba) and university procurement are predominantly registration/login-gated.

Tier-3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery and major-buyer portals (BHP/Rio/Fortescue/Woodside/Santos; Woolworths/Coles; CBA/Westpac/NAB/ANZ; Telstra/Optus; AGL/Origin; Qantas) returned no publicly-visible open RFx via WebSearch; posting boards are registration-gated and buyer events often invitation-only (out of scope). Portals recorded in discovered_sources; no corporate tenders fabricated.
Australian Museum 'Data Centre Infrastructure & Managed Services Provider' EOI (EOI-2014604) surfaced but closed 28 April 2026 - not current; not recorded.

Aggregator signals only (NOT recorded as confirmed tenders, per the buyer-originated rule): numerous australiantenders.com.au / bidsfactory / projectory / tenderalerts.au listings for NSW/VIC/QLD/WA councils and agencies with no verifiable buyer-originated detail page reachable this run (e.g. Cloncurry Shire T2026-024 Railway Street Watermain closing ~2 Nov 2026 via Tenderlink).
recommended_seed_additions: National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR) - procurement via VendorPanel - https://wws.nhvr.gov.au/about-us/procurement (buyer-originated; new this run).

Allow-list the Tier-1 tender domains AND buyer domains (e.g. acara.edu.au) in the session network policy so future runs can open and verify detail pages and documents - currently all DNS-blocked, forcing headline-level-only capture.
